title: Invite a member and open the console
caption: Invitations, roles and the single sign-on into the OTA admin.

steps.title: Invite
steps.body: `POST /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/invitations {email, role}` (admins may invite agent, finance, viewer only).

steps.title: Look up and accept
steps.body: `POST /v1/invitations/lookup {token}` (public), then signed in with the invited, verified address `POST /v1/invitations/accept {token}`.
steps.expect: Membership created; invitation `accepted`; mismatching address `403 INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH`; expired or used link `400 INVITATION_INVALID`.

steps.title: Change a role
steps.expect: Demoting or removing the last owner `409 LAST_OWNER`; vx:invalidate membership.

steps.title: Open console
steps.expect: `{portalToken: ptk_…, expiresAt (+60 s), consoleSsoUrl}`; Redis key `ptk:<sha256>`; the OTA admin redeems it once.
